lines.say: Creatine. What does it actually do?
Your muscles run on a tiny energy molecule called A T P.
In a hard set, you burn through it in seconds.
Creatine helps you rebuild it, fast.
Taking it can raise the creatine in your muscles by about twenty to forty percent.
So you squeeze out an extra rep or two. Over months, that adds up.
Studies usually use three to five grams a day.
It's one of the most studied supplements there is. Kidney problems? Ask a doctor first.
